1.0.0: Your cameras on the desktop, in the colours of the wallpaper behind them
Installed with the camera panel, which owns the cameras and the frames

summary: The camera panel's cameras, as a grid on the desktop
description: A desktop card for the Cameras panel. It shows the cameras the panel knows about, keeps the frames running only while the card is on screen, and pins a camera when you click it. Installing the Cameras panel installs this card with it.
